## X-Sense Home Security v1.4.20.10

### 📷 Camera Motion
- Restores the live Detected/Clear Motion binary sensor for X-Sense cameras.
- Reports one Motion event for each new camera detection without turning ordinary camera refreshes or clear updates into events.
- Preserves the latest reported motion state when camera metadata refreshes do not include a motion value.

### 📚 Documentation
- Updates camera Motion documentation across all supported documentation languages.
